**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity).**

- **Transition assistance — compliant limb:** § 11.4 (p0192) already meets the preferred position on assistance: it triggers on expiry *or any termination for any reason*, runs up to six (6) months, and continued Services are billed at contract rates (only Expenses at then-current rates), which is better than the playbook preferred.
- **Data return — fails fallback:** No provision anywhere requires M&I to return Customer Data. § 17.1 confirms our ownership and § 17.5 imposes only safeguarding duties; searches for return/export/deconversion language found nothing. Export within 30 days is material to both the preferred *and* the fallback position.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 11.5 requiring return of all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, followed by deletion and written certification — leaving the existing six-month assistance mechanics untouched.
